XXX wrote:

Hi Nick, Thanks so much for your assistance. We’ve run BioGeoBEARS and we are getting some really cool results! A quick question, our tree is really mushed, basically impossible to read the terminals. My student read on the google group there wasn’t a way to change that, but I have seen publications where the branches and terminals are spread out. Do you know how they did this? Thanks!!

XXX


Hi!  Yeah, just change the height and width options in the pdf() command.  

You can also change these to change the sizes of 
tipcex=0.7, statecex=0.7, splitcex=0.6, titlecex=0.8

...to change the size of the text and symbols, cex=character expansion

PS: Change runslow to FALSE throughout the script to make new PDFs without re-doing the slow optimization step.

Cheers!
Nick
